description: This Java class provides SSL/TLS handling for MQTT connections, including SSL context creation, trust manager customization, and certificate validation with device credential verification.

classes.name: MqttSslHandlerProvider
classes.description: Provides SSL handler setup for MQTT with custom trust management and certificate validation.

classes.name: ThingsboardMqttX509TrustManager
classes.description: Custom X509TrustManager that validates device certificates and interacts with transport service for credential verification.

methods.name: getSslHandler
methods.description: Creates and configures an SslHandler with SSL engine for MQTT.

methods.name: createSslContext
methods.description: Initializes SSLContext with credentials, trust managers, and protocol.

methods.name: getX509TrustManager
methods.description: Wraps a standard X509TrustManager with custom validation logic.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: Validates client certificate chain and verifies device credentials via transport service.

methods.name: validateCertificateChain
methods.description: Verifies the chain of X509 certificates.
